No address residue in the name.
purpose: Chapter 15 turn-9 / phase-0 turn-event handler (dispatch idx 0x12): show dialog page 8, then disarm the per-event AI/dialog control flag (low 4 bits of combat_aux_block[0xD]) by writing 0 across runtime chars 0x10..0x22.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch: (1) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=8, fixed dialog geometry 0xA0000,0x140,0xCD,0x4C,0x4A,0x13,1) -- its uint32 return is discarded; (2) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(start=0x10, end=0x22, value=0) -- sets the low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD] to 0 for the 19 inclusive chars 0x10..0x22 (the ch15 second-wave AI/dialog disarm). No RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value consumed. Body never reads event_arg. __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected. In the original binary the function's tail at 0x34F37 (PUSH 0x10) and 0x34F39 (CALL ...) double as class-3 shared tails that other handlers (0x2B/0x2D/0x54 and 0x2C/0x30) JMP into; that is a code-folding layout artifact, reproduced here only as this function's own inline call.
